ezdxf: Always set release='R2010' or 'R2018' with setup=True for maximum compatibility with AutoCAD LT and modern CAD readers.
Never call .format() on templates containing LaTeX math without escaping curly braces or using custom delimiters like {{KEY}}.
Add entities directly to Modelspace (doc.modelspace()) and assign explicit engineering layers with ACI color codes (1=Red, 2=Yellow, 3=Green, 4=Cyan).
Use add_lwpolyline with closed=True for boundaries, foundations, and room areas to ensure area queries succeed.
openpyxl: Use data_only=False when generating live formulas (=SUM, =IF) so Excel evaluates them upon opening.
Always set explicit column widths using get_column_letter() to prevent '###' truncation errors in printed schedules.
Use corporate theme fills (Navy Blue header: 1F4E79, Soft Green safe: E2EFDA, Soft Red warning: FCE4D6).
cad_space_extraction: Use the Ray Casting algorithm for fast Point-in-Polygon checks to determine which room text label belongs to which polyline boundary.
Use the Shoelace formula to compute exact net polygon area in square meters.
Filter out microscopic polylines (< 1.0 m2) and colossal perimeter site boundaries (> 5000 m2) to isolate actual room spaces.
